name: Underground Sepulcher
summary: Underground Sepulcher is a tomb that serves as a heist location. You'll be taken here by Fa'ren-dar during the related quest. Several factions can inhabit the sepulcher, including the Ember-Eye Slavers, the Red Rooks and the Worm Cult.
notes: Scouting Report: Underground Sepulcher has a bit of information about this location.
